title: Dead Sea Scrolls Isaiah matches text a thousand years later

tellings.quote: Wes Huff when he was on my podcast explained to me that the book of Isaiah that they found in the Dead Sea Scrolls is verbatim the same as the book of Isaiah that was a thousand years more recent.

plain: The copy of the biblical Book of Isaiah found among the Dead Sea Scrolls, ancient Jewish manuscripts discovered near the Dead Sea at Qumran, is said to match word for word a version of Isaiah written a thousand years later. The podcaster Joe Rogan repeats this on Michels's show as something a guest of his own, a man named Wes Huff, explained to him on Rogan's podcast. It is told as a sign of how faithfully ancient texts were copied down the centuries.
